_help: luk-assist answers. Fill in only what is true for you. Empty values and <placeholders> are never typed into a form. per_question keys match (ignoring case and accents) any question label that contains them. Keep this file out of any repository.

profile.titulo: <your degree or profession, e.g. Ingeniería Comercial>
profile.experiencia: <two to four sentences about your relevant experience>
profile.idioma: <languages and level, e.g. Español nativo; inglés intermedio>
profile.edad: <your age, only if you want to share it>

fixed.salary: <expected monthly net salary in CLP, digits only>
